safe.label: Office 2013+ / WPS 2016+
safe.notes: SVG-backed images must carry a PNG fallback; animations limited to the basic whitelist; audio mp3/m4a only.

standard.label: Office 2016+ / WPS 2019+ (default)
standard.notes: The v1 release claim. Everything the fusion ships today sits inside this level.

max.label: Microsoft 365
max.notes: Not the default: a deck that uses morph cannot be opened meaningfully by WPS or old Office.

measured.note: Also the only version-sensitive marker a pptwise-produced deck carries (plan 1.5), so it is the one entry both engines already exercise.
Not producible by pptwise at all; ppt-master exposes it through its transition registry. Levels safe/standard downgrade it to fade.

measured.presentIn: the fade transition ppt-master writes by default
measured.note: Grouped by the master transition namespace list; anything above the level's allowance downgrades to fade rather than being dropped.

measured.presentIn: nothing we emit today (no animation pass yet; M4 owns it)
measured.note: The MCE fallback pair must survive the merge intact, which is why M4.10 tests AlternativeContent migration.

measured.presentIn: nothing we emit today: the native-shape export ignores compat mode (builder.py: 'ignored in native mode')
measured.note: Becomes live with SVG-image content (formulas, imported SVG icons, template materialisation) in M5. The PNG sibling cannot be produced on this machine by the Python stack at all, so B7's Node-side rasteriser (sharp) owns it (docs/compat/probe.md).

measured.presentIn: nothing we emit today (no formula page in the fixture set)
measured.note: ppt-master writes Choice=a14:m with a linear-text Fallback; the lint must check the pair rather than trust it.

measured.presentIn: nothing we emit today: the fixture chart is a plain column chart
measured.note: The native-object marker payload names the chart type, so the downgrade is a payload edit before export, not an XML rewrite.
Levels safe and standard refuse it; max allows it.

measured.presentIn: nothing we emit today (narrate lands in M5; edge-tts writes mp3)
measured.note: safe/standard restrict the media container to mp3/m4a.

measured.presentIn: pptwise CJK decks (S12); the deep path inherits fonts from the authored SVG
measured.note: WPS substitutes fonts aggressively, so the east-asian slot must exist on every run of CJK text; the substitution list lives in docs/compat/fonts.md.
Upstream template_validation.py rejects duplicate ids; the merge bridge inherits that rule (M4.10).
